title: NAILS discard --json
description: Machine-readable discard envelope (contract version 2): one document with schema_version, command, ok, and either data (the hidden upper removed for a path) or error. The envelope frame, the data and the error body are strict. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9. A declined prompt, or Ctrl+C at it, is the shared cancel shape: the error `cancelled`, no data, exit 130. An internal error is the error `internal_error`, exit 1.

target.description: The path whose hidden copy was discarded.

removed.description: The directories removed from the hidden volume; empty when there was nothing to discard.
